claims.statement: The native UI (t3k::ui) laid out every screen in the fixed design space of core/Design.h: kWidth = 1024, kHeight = 578 (content only; Figma's 600 includes a 22px mock titlebar), plus chrome strips that grow the window instead of squishing the core: kBannerHeight=44, kHintHeight=36, kHeaderHeight=45, kPlateHeight=108; kMaxScale = 2.0 (editor corner-drag scale ceiling). NativeEditor applies a single AffineTransform so no child component ever sees window size — this is a port of useUiScale.ts (1 design px = 1 JUCE logical unit).

Services (services/Services.h) is the per-editor bundle of stores: UiClock (one 30 Hz tick every poller shares), ChainStore (revision-poll + optimistic edits), MeterStore, PresetStore, AudioDeviceStore (standalone only), MidiMapStore, UiPrefs, HintBus, Toast, Banners, ParamBinding, AutoMeasure, SpectrumFeed, TunerFeed, ModelLoads, LocalFiles, ImageLoader, ConnectionGate, UpdateCheck, ToneLoadFlow, Zoom, Pointer, and the TONE3000 cloud stack (HttpClient, OAuth, LoopbackServer, Tone3000Client, Tone3000Session). Ownership: NativeEditor → Services → PluginRoot → views; views hold references to the services they use and register as listeners in the constructor / unregister in the destructor. No singletons: two editors in one process never see each other's state.

The testbed (plugin/ui/testbed) is a standalone JUCE app (UiTestbed) that renders PluginRoot against a fixture-driven MockBackend + MockSession: --scenario for live windows, --capture [refDir] for 2x PNG screenshots + diff tables, --compare before/after for single pairs, --selftest for unit tests (pure logic + focus policy in a real window), --bench [--seconds N] [--json] for CPU / memory under realistic phase loads. Its own project keeps UI iteration from rebuilding the DSP tree; -DT3K_BUILD_UI_TESTBED=ON on the plugin build registers --selftest with ctest (CI runs it next to the DSP suite).

The view tree from NativeEditor (owns UiPrefs, HttpClient, Tone3000Session, Services, PluginRoot; scales the 1024-wide design space) is: PluginRoot → PluginHeader (PresetBar / AccountMenu / StereoModeToggle) + AppBanner + middle (MainScreen chain + faceplate | BlockCard for a single-block detail view | TunerView; ToneBrowser takes over middle + Faceplate while open; SignInScreen takes that slot while signing in) + Faceplate + HintBar + OverlayLayer (Settings, modals, popovers, Toast). BlockCard (views/block/BlockCard.h) is the per-block card (Tone + Mix + power) that syncHeader() re-selects its tone without recreating the in-flight handler's closure, per the data flow rule.

The reverb tile's Dry knob uses scales::reverbDry(), a standalone scale that mirrors scales::convGain() exactly (toDisplay linear-maps 0..1 to -24..+24 dB, toStored/fromStored are the identity, format renders signed dB). It is a separate scale so reverb-tile and conv-tile each name their own dry face independently; the conv tile's convDry knob keeps using scales::convGain().

Knob FACE SIZE (R3 UI addendum, 2026-10-16): the compact knob face (kCompactKnobFace = 32 px, defined at plugin/ui/views/gallery/EffectTile.cpp:21) now applies to compact tiles AND the convolution AND the reverb full tile — the R3 scope addendum (user request: reverb full-tile knobs should look like the convolver tile). Implementation: 14 ternary sites in EffectTile.cpp now read `(compact_ || block_.effectKind == "convolution" || block_.effectKind == "reverb") ? kCompactKnobFace : theme::kKnobSizeSecondary` (the knob() helpers at ~:311-:343, Knob::heightFor at ~:343, and the SigA/SigB rows); the labelSize couples to the face size — inside knob() (`if (faceSize != theme::kKnobSizeSecondary) o.labelSize = 12.0f;` at ~:36), i.e. the 32-px face carries a 12.0-px label (at 14 px the 'Shape'/'Width' labels touched inside 38-px columns; at 12 px both clear). The effectKind == "reverb" param-stream gates at :365/:367 (Mod+Dry on the compact surface) and the 6+6 layout are unchanged by this addendum.

FINAL reverb full-tile layout after T-DAT-001 face waves 2+3 (2026-10-17; supersedes the pre-wave face and the 8-entry Space-included layout): the compact face applies kCompactKnobFace = 32 px to compact + convolution + reverb-full tiles (12.0 px labels). The 6x2 grid is: ROW 1 = Mix (chain-level, first slot, squared at read path in Processor.cpp) | Decay | LoCut (reverbLoCut, fraction 0..0.85, linear loCutTaper toStored = 0.85*pow(n,0.7)) | Tone | Air (reverbAir, sigKnob_ slot 0) | Mod (reverbSharedMod, wave 3 rebind from the old reverbMod binding). ROW 2 = Dwell (reverbInput, row-2 slot 0, visible on the reverb face via `input_.setVisible(reverb && compact)`-style gate) | Pre | Early (reverbEarly, modKnob_ slot 1) | Size | Width | Out (chain-level, last slot). Space (reverbSpace) is OFF the face: user pinned space=0.73f in code; the param still exists in ChainBlock/Params but has no visible knob on the PLT reverb face. The two SIG slots (Air row 1, Early row 2) are re-voiced per mode by reverbSigParam/Label/ScaleForMode. numParams_ for the reverb face = 8 engine params + Mix + Out chain-level entries. TileShot goldens plugin/ui/testbed/goldens/reverb.png + reverb-shift.png were re-shot after user review and the goldens re-approved at 0 px diff (docs/agents/ui-snapshots.md flow: human approve -> --regen). The 2026-10-17 node-view ticket also added the gallery|node toggle to PluginHeader (left of the preset bar, UiPrefs kNodeView, wired to ChainScreen::setView — see the node-view page); the 2026-10-17 closeout DspTests count is 512 (advanced from 511 by same-day theme/OCR/label work).

COMPRESSOR TYPE CYCLER (commit 3ffb35b; label order fixed 2026-10-14, commit 5f93ab9): the full compressor tile carries a per-mode TYPE cycler button (typeCycle_, a juce::TextButton) that mirrors the reverb tile's type cycler. Bounds (resized(), full view): typeCycle_ at (W - 14 - 44, 44, 44, 26) — right of the mode selector, which slides left to modeCombo_ (W - 14 - 44 - 8 - 120, 44, 120, 26); both share the y=44 band. It is HIDDEN in the compact tile (typeCycle_.setVisible(!compact_)) because the compact header's free slot (65..95) belongs to the PUNCH toggle and 28..62 to the mode cycler, and with one self-type per mode the cycler is a one-entry no-op until a mode gains a second type. Button text = compactCompTypeName(block_.compMode, compType): the self-type labels in ENGINE-index order {VCA, TUB, OPT, FET, VMU} (0=VCA 1=Tube 2=Opto 3=FET 4=Vari-Mu; the 5f93ab9 fix reordered the array from the old display order {… VMU, FET} so the chip text matches the loaded engine — FET is the 1176, Vari-Mu the 670). Help text = help::text(help::Key::compType) (a Key in Help.h, desktop blurb in Help.cpp) + a per-mode compTypeBlurb ("general-purpose VCA -- smooth RMS soft-knee compression" / "Tube-STA -- warm tube detector, the output-stage saturation" / "Opto-2A -- two-stage optical cells, ratio-dependent slow attack" / "FET -- four-amp sum, fast transient grab + stage coloration" / "Vari-Mu 670 -- release-position ladder, feedback detection, odd-only crunch"); the compMode help text in Help.cpp distinguishes FET (the 1176 four-amp feedback detector) from Vari-Mu (the Fairchild 670 release-position ladder). onClick opens a PopupMenu listing i in [0, Compressor::numTypes(m)) as "<label> — <blurb>" (current checked) and calls enterCompType(choice-1). syncCompTypeButton(m) re-syncs button + help text (called from enterMode); enterCompType(type) is a no-op if type == compTypeOf(block_), else sets block_.compType VERBATIM (the engine clamps via setParams/numTypes) and calls services().chain.setBlockParam(blockId(), "compType", (double)type), then syncCompTypeButton.

The 2026-10-14 swappable-theme change converted the Theme.h colour tokens from compile-time constants to mutable `inline juce::Colour` globals, added `struct ThemePalette` (a snapshot of every token), and `applyPalette(const ThemePalette&)` / `resetPalette()` which restore the defaults. The live (NativeEditor/Processor) UI always uses the defaults; palette swapping is a testbed-only feature (TileShot/UiTestbed), so the shipped plugin looks unchanged.

The 2026-10-14 OCR capture mode adds `--ocr` to TileShot (and UiTestbed capture): it calls `theme::applyPalette(theme::ocrPalette())` before building the component (and `resetPalette()` after) to render a black-on-white high-contrast variant where the 12px type-chip labels become machine-readable. `theme::ocrPalette()` (a function-local static in Theme.h) maps brandBlue/Yellow/Red and linkBlue to black and all dark-surface tokens to white. `script/tile-ocr.sh` shoots a tile with `--ocr`, crops a button region by design coordinates, up-scales + binarizes, and reads it with Tesseract (psm 7/13/10, char whitelist A-Z) — the measured pass bar is the comp-shift type chip reading its model letter.

The swappable-theme ticket added test/src/theme_palette_tests.cpp to DspTests, which compiles the real plugin/ui/core/Theme.h and guards the palette contract: the default palette round-trips through applyPalette/resetPalette, and ocrPalette() inverts the brand colours to black while keeping white text on white surfaces.

DspTests compiles the real plugin DSP sources plus exactly FOUR plugin/ui files: plugin/ui/core/Labels.cpp (the KnobScale readout formatter the scale-contract tests link), plugin/ui/views/nodeview/NodeModel.cpp + plugin/ui/model/ChainState.cpp (the node grid's read-side model and its data source), and plugin/ui/views/gallery/EffectParams.cpp (the shared paramsFor knob table, added by the node-view batch 2 for the strip_knob_tests.cpp per-knob readout tests); test/CMakeLists.txt adds the include paths plugin/ui, plugin/ui/core, plugin/ui/views/nodeview, and plugin/ui/views/gallery. The theme palette is exercised by theme_palette_tests.cpp's #include of plugin/ui/core/Theme.h. Everything else in plugin/ui (views, widgets, services, NativeEditor) is excluded, so a green DspTests run does NOT prove the UI links: UI changes must be verified via the testbed (--selftest / --capture) or a GUI plugin build target before committing. (Suite-size snapshots live in /openwiki/build-and-ops/dsp-test-suite.md; as of the 2026-10-17 batch-3 pass the suite was 538 tests / 79 suites — the count is a lower-bound snapshot, never a stale-total assertion.)

juce-end-to-end supplement (2026-10-18, commit f0b06d4; drag-UX closeout 6df21a2; m06828 batch 72f48ea): UiTestbed links the in-tree focusrite-e2e C++ transport (libs/focusrite-e2e, node_modules/ gitignored) and is inert unless launched with --e2e-test-port=N; NodeViewE2E.cpp registers a focusrite::e2e::CommandHandler driven from PluginRoot (PluginRoot::setNodeViewViewE2E exposes the pref+setView pair for node-set-view) with real-pointer drag commands (node-drag-begin/move/end, events routed to the mouseDown source cell per JUCE's drag semantics; since 72f48ea a node-drag-press command stamps NodeView::setE2eReleaseButton around a synthetic release — mouseWasClicked(int) does not exist in JUCE 9, so the handler tells the view which button just went up) plus node-cells/node-geometry/node-tree/node-screenshot probes. The JS regression plugin/ui/testbed/e2e/node-drag.js (35 check() asserts — grown from the initial 13 by the 2026-10-18 drag-UX closeout and the m06828 additions that pinned the positional far-drop and right-press-during-drag laws; run `xvfb-run -a node plugin/ui/testbed/e2e/node-drag.js`, with T3K_E2E_APP env override to point at a working UiTestbed build) guards the opaque full-size ghost + drag-UX laws.
